results.comment: Observed the fixture initially showing “BLOCKED: Location permission is required.” and “RATIONALE: true”. Tapped REQUEST LOCATION PERMISSION, observed Android’s permission dialog, and tapped “Don’t allow”. The fixture then showed exact status “BLOCKED: Location permission is required.” and “RATIONALE: false”. Visible controls: REQUEST LOCATION PERMISSION, REFRESH PERMISSION STATE, and USE LOCATION FEATURE.
results.action: Tap Request location permission a second time. If Android displays a permission dialog, tap Don't allow. Return to the fixture and record the exact status, RATIONALE value, and visible controls.
